title: Federal Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Federal Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

FEDERAL PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
FEDERAL PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLIX OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Federal Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1977
[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary, Part-I, 3rd September, 2002]
F. No.2 (1)/2002-Pub. dated
3-9-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Federal Public Service
Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Federal Public Service Commission Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 7, Ordinance XLV of 1977

FEDERAL PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
FEDERAL PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLIX OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Federal Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1977
[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary, Part-I, 3rd September, 2002]
F. No.2 (1)/2002-Pub. dated
3-9-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 7,
Ordinance XLV of 1977.--In the Federal Public Service Commission Ordinance,
1977 (XLV of 1977), in section 7, in subsection (1),--
(a) in clause
(b), in sub-clause (iii), for the full stop, at the end, the semicolon and word
"and" shall be substituted; and
(b) after clause
(b), amended as aforesaid, the following new clause shall be added, namely:--
"(c) to
hold examination for promotion for such posts as the Federal Government may,
from time to time, by notification in the official Gazette, specify."
